description: This file defines the StreamRequestPayloadMiddleware class used within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class acts as middleware to handle streaming request payloads, determining when to add headers such as 'transfer-encoding' or 'content-length' based on the operation's input members and stream status.

classes.name: StreamRequestPayloadMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling streaming request payloads in AWS SDK for PHP. It inspects the operation input members and request headers to decide whether to add 'transfer-encoding' or 'content-length' headers, throwing an exception if payload length cannot be determined.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that creates a middleware wrapper function binding a specific AWS service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a handler and service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware logic to process the command and request, adding necessary headers for streaming payloads.
